test: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
rationale: The failure is `connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3999` on both the initial attempt and retry, with durationMs 38ms — the test never reached the app. The diff shows playwright.config.ts was changed to hardcode baseURL to port 3999 instead of using the configured PORT, so the test is pointed at a port where no server is listening. This is a test-environment/infrastructure misconfiguration (wrong port), not a product regression or a flaky timing issue.
recommendedAction: Revert the playwright.config.ts change so baseURL uses the configured PORT (or start the app on 3999), then rerun the test; verify the webServer/baseURL port matches the port the app actually binds to.
